notes: Sides: just inside the inner straight rule that runs inside the thick bar. Corners now follow the inner arc, per the owner (README rule 2): at each corner the edge runs ~3 px inside the inner edge of the innermost (thin) arc, points every ~15-30 px, joining the side rule where the arc merges into it; the arcs, the corner-triangle ink and everything between them and the corner are outside. The small step in the bottom rule at x~350 is the bottom-left arc's tail. Blocks on the left run right up to the inner rule and cross the bottom-left arc; the edge keeps the rule outside and cuts the blocks at the arc. Holes (README rule 4, floating blocks are frame): (1) the CITY & COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO / USE OF PROPERTY / ZONE MAP title, LEGEND and scale bar block (bottom right); (2) the compass rose with its north arrow and needle (right, over the bay); (3) the SECTION 1 circle badge (top right corner); (4) the hand-lettered 'Join Sec. 8' cross-reference (lower middle, beside the diagonal street; the hole edge runs between it and the street-name 'St.' just above). All four sit on blank paper; none overlaps map ink. 'Join Sec. 2' on the left is outside the frame bar, so already outside. The BAY OF SAN FRANCISCO lettering names the city's water and stays map.
